scope: Exploratory diagnosis selected after observing EC vision mismatch; not a confirmatory acceptance rule.
resampling_unit: whole run, same retained draws as prior cohort analysis
band: Mean plus/minus the 0.95 type7 quantile of the maximum absolute bootstrap deviation standardized by the original standard error over 286 column centers. Fixed standard errors, not bootstrap-t.
limits: Approximate bootstrap band for our mean curve, not a confidence band for the historical paper.
Selected metric after inspection; no simultaneous guarantee across other metrics or cohorts.
Comparison uses column centers and vertical raster bounds; not the previous horizontal-window range statistic.
Overlap does not establish equivalence; no posthoc change to replication criteria.
